project_type: React 18 SPA with TypeScript and Vite
verification_instructions: 1. Run vite build to ensure no compile errors. 2. Run vitest run to ensure existing tests pass. 3. Grep for removed color patterns (#1976d2, #f44336, #2e7d32 etc.) to ensure they are replaced.
environment_constraints: No Docker daemon. Use host-based validation with vite build and vitest.
contribution_requirements: Visual-only changes. Do NOT modify business logic, stores, or engines. Keep all data-testid attributes intact.
key_patterns: Design system CSS custom properties defined in src/styles/design-system.css. Utility classes in components.css (.btn-primary, .btn-secondary, .btn-tertiary, .input, .input-readonly, .panel, .panel-header, .status-chip variants, .table-minimal). Typography in typography.css (--font-mono for IBM Plex Mono, --font-sans for Inter). Layout classes in layout.css. Colors: accent=#9A7B4F, success=#3F6B4F, error=#B0413E, warning=#A66A2D, canvas=#F6F5F3, surface=#FFFFFF, ink=#1A1A1A, secondary=#6E6E6E, hairline=#E3E1DD, disabled=#D8D5D0.
directory_structure: frontend/src/styles/ - CSS design system files. frontend/src/pages/admin/ - Admin page components. frontend/src/components/ - Reusable components organized by domain (BomPanel, SkuBrowser, TemplateManagement, PublishWorkflow, ProjectCreation, Finalization). frontend/src/stores/ - Zustand stores. frontend/src/types/ - TypeScript types.
